objective: Phase 6: Add AgentDojo and InjecAgent external benchmark adapters
acceptance_criteria: benchmarks/schema.py defines standard adapter record schema with stable case ID, source name and revision, license, source family, setup, task text, injected content, benign target effect, malicious target effect, and required tools
benchmarks/manifest.lock pins upstream revisions, licenses, imported subset, and explicitly documents excluded cases with unsupported capability reasons
benchmarks/agentdojo_adapter.py deterministically imports and converts pinned AgentDojo cases to XProto scenario schema
benchmarks/injecagent_adapter.py deterministically imports and converts pinned InjecAgent cases to XProto scenario schema
scenarios/external/ contains agentdojo.json and injecagent.json converted scenarios executable against MCP, A2A, and XGate
src/xproto/eval.py supports evaluating benchmark suites independently and outputs separate summaries (summary_agentdojo.json/md, summary_injecagent.json/md) and mechanism-level comparisons
tests/test_benchmark_adapters.py verifies adapter conversions, schema adherence, exclusion tracking, and evaluation compatibility
non_goals: Do not implement Phase 7 deeper multi-hop topologies (chains >= 5) or cryptographic token integrity yet
